description: Creates a workout program from team workouts. Use when the user wants to organize workouts into a multi-week program. Requires goal_ids (1-2) and workout_ids (min 2).

description.description: Short program description shown to members.

goal_ids.description: 1 or 2 program goal IDs from list_team_goals.

team_id.description: Not used: this tool works on the signed-in team. Leave it out.

visibility.description: Who sees it: "public" shows it to members and in public lists; "private" keeps it to the team. Defaults to "public".

workout_ids.description: Ordered workout IDs from list_team_workouts, at least 2. Repeat an ID to schedule it again.

name: create_program
title: Create program
